tools.name: open_tool
tools.description: Open an Artificial Studio tool on the app, optionally prefilling the prompt. This leaves the marketing site and navigates to app.artificialstudio.ai — it does not run a generation, the user still presses the button.

tool_slug.description: Tool slug, e.g. 'create-image'. Get it from search_tools.

prompt.description: Optional text to prefill the tool's prompt field.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Artificial Studio catalog of AI tools (image, video, audio, 3D). Returns matching tools with their slug and the URL of their playground on the app. Use this before open_tool.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. 'remove background', 'text to speech', 'image to 3d'.
